Subject: Post-demo: monthly burn estimate + burst window timing (LumenEdge)

Hi Samir / Jenna —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and the concrete asks we agreed to surface so we can get you a tight hosted pricing band: 

Ask list (what I need from you):
- Confirm an expected monthly token volume range (input + generated tokens). You mentioned an initial pilot + ramp; a helpful shape is: low / expected / high for month 1–3.
- Confirm typical prompt sizes (avg input tokens) and expected average generated tokens per request (so we can estimate tokens per completed call).
- Confirm peak-burst behavior: you said there are 10–20 minute morning bursts where TPS spikes — can you confirm expected 99th percentile TPS during those bursts and typical burst duration?
- Target $/1M tokens (budget range) for the hosted API, and whether you can consider a committed slab if we show a material discount.
- Any procurement constraints (SOW, PO cadence, or required vendor forms) — copying procurement if helpful.

From our side: preliminary sizing assumptions (please call out if any are off):
- We modeled two options for hosted: a conservative band (suitable for <10M tokens/month) and a mid-band for 10–40M tokens/month.
- Hosted can absorb short bursts (10–30 minutes) with our autoscale/burst pool but sustained >5m QPS for >30 minutes is a better fit for Dedicated.

Attached: LumenEdge_token_projections.xlsx (template) and sample-api-payloads.jsonl — populate the token column if possible and send back.

Next step: if you can return the filled projection and confirm the burst numbers by EOD Thursday, I’ll send a hosted pricing band and an optional Dedicated comparator.

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Great recap, thanks. Attached is a quick fill of the projection template (see LumenEdge_token_projections.xlsx) and a short note below to clarify the numbers you asked about.

Monthly volume (best-effort ranges):
- Pilot months (1–2): 6M – 10M tokens/month
- Post-pilot steady state (months 3–12): 18M – 25M tokens/month
- High stress / new feature launch scenario: up to ~45M tokens/month for a short runway (1–2 months).

Prompt / response size (avg):
- Avg input tokens per call: 120 tokens
- Avg generated tokens per call: 340 tokens
- So roughly ~460 tokens per completed call on average.

Peak / burst behavior:
- Morning window (US ET 8:30–9:00) drives most spikes — we see 55–70 TPS for ~10–15 minutes in that window on business days.
- Secondary smaller spikes (20–30 TPS) around lunchtime for ~5–8 minutes.

Budget target and constraints:
- Procurement target for hosted: $12–$16 per 1M tokens (we know that’s tight; willing to talk about a 6–12 month committed slab for discount).
- PO / SOW cadence: monthly invoice; procurement will need standard security questionnaire + SOC2 evidence before final sign.

Let me know if you need finer grain by endpoint (we have two primary endpoints with slightly different response lengths).

—Samir
Samir Rao | Head of Product, LumenEdge
samir@lumenedge.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo: monthly burn estimate + burst window timing (LumenEdge)

Samir — really helpful, appreciate the ranges and the filled sheet. Quick notes and next steps from our side: 

1) Pricing band (hosted) — ballpark back-of-envelope (illustrative, not final):
- Pilot band (6–10M tokens/mo): $20 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Growth band (18–25M tokens/mo): $14 – $17 / 1M tokens with a 6–12 month slab commitment (slabs tier down at higher commit levels)
- High stress scenario (40–45M transient): recommend a short-term Dedicated evaluation to lower unit economics for sustained periods.

2) Burst handling — hosted can support your 55–70 TPS short bursts via burst pool; we throttle gracefully beyond configured SLOs. If you need guaranteed 99th percentile SLO for those bursts, Dedicated or reserved pools are a better match.

3) Procurement & security — noted. Monica, can you please share the SOC2 evidence pack link and the redwood vendor pack to Samir / procurement?

4) Next steps for us / action items:
- (Samir) confirm whether the 55–70 TPS is the 99th percentile in the morning burst or a short-lived 100th-percentile spike. If it’s sustained at 99th for >15 minutes we should model Dedicated.
- (Samir) confirm whether the two endpoints differ materially in avg generated tokens (if so, send the endpoint breakdown).
- (Marissa) I’ll send a short hosted pricing band doc and a quick Dedicated comparator by EOD tomorrow.
- (Karthik/Monica) prepare a short MAT (mutual action template) and security snapshot to reduce procurement friction.

I’m attaching a one-pager hosted-pricing-bands.pdf with the above bands (approx).

If you’d like, I can also schedule a focused 30-min follow-up with my infra partner (Karthik) to run through burst modeling.

Thanks —
Marissa

- If they can commit to a 9–12 month slab at the 18–25M run-rate, we can tighten to ~$13.25 / 1M tokens (still need legal to confirm wording).

I’ll join the follow-up call if scheduled — available Wed 9–11 PT.
